Test Scenario: Retrieve all user records
Expected Result: Returns JSON array with list of users
Actual Result: Returned JSON array of 10 user objects

Test Scenario: Validate response headers content-type
Expected Result: Content-Type header contains application/json
Actual Result: Content-Type header is application/json; charset=utf-8

Test Scenario: Verify response time is acceptable
Expected Result: Response time is under 1500ms
Actual Result: Response received in ~350ms

Test Scenario: Validate schema and essential fields of users list
Expected Result: Each object contains id name username and email
Actual Result: Array objects contain id name username email address etc.

Actual Result: Returned array with 1 user object matching email

Expected Result: Returns 404 Not Found
